fullContentHtml:
MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the Primary & Middle School Teacher Post. The Applications for the MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 has Started from 21 August 2026, & Candidate can apply till 05 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 August 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 1000/-
  • Portal Charge : Rs. 60/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Date Extended Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
